description_json.name: Vowel-Consonant Alternating Shift
description_json.idea: To make it easier for the model to reason and maintain semantic coherence, we use a simple, highly structured shift cipher. Instead of a uniform shift or a complex keyboard mapping, we apply a small, predictable shift based on character type: vowels are shifted forward by 1 in the vowel sequence (a->e, e->i, i->o, o->u, u->a), and consonants are shifted forward by 1 in the consonant alphabet sequence. Case is preserved. Non-alphabetic characters remain unchanged.
description_json.encrypt_rules:
1. Define the vowel sequence: 'aeiou' for lowercase, 'AEIOU' for uppercase.
2. Define the consonant sequence: 'bcdfghjklmnpqrstvwxyz' for lowercase, 'BCDFGHJKLMNPQRSTVWXYZ' for uppercase.
3. For each character in the plaintext:
   a. If it is a lowercase vowel, replace it with the next vowel in 'aeiou' (wrapping 'u' to 'a').
   b. If it is an uppercase vowel, replace it with the next vowel in 'AEIOU' (wrapping 'U' to 'A').
   c. If it is a lowercase consonant, replace it with the next consonant in 'bcdfghjklmnpqrstvwxyz' (wrapping 'z' to 'b').
   d. If it is an uppercase consonant, replace it with the next consonant in 'BCDFGHJKLMNPQRSTVWXYZ' (wrapping 'Z' to 'B').
   e. If it is any other character (number, space, punctuation), leave it unchanged.
description_json.decrypt_rules:
1. Define the vowel sequence: 'aeiou' for lowercase, 'AEIOU' for uppercase.
2. Define the consonant sequence: 'bcdfghjklmnpqrstvwxyz' for lowercase, 'BCDFGHJKLMNPQRSTVWXYZ' for uppercase.
3. For each character in the ciphertext:
   a. If it is a lowercase vowel, replace it with the previous vowel in 'aeiou' (wrapping 'a' to 'u').
   b. If it is an uppercase vowel, replace it with the previous vowel in 'AEIOU' (wrapping 'A' to 'U').
   c. If it is a lowercase consonant, replace it with the previous consonant in 'bcdfghjklmnpqrstvwxyz' (wrapping 'b' to 'z').
   d. If it is an uppercase consonant, replace it with the previous consonant in 'BCDFGHJKLMNPQRSTVWXYZ' (wrapping 'B' to 'Z').
   e. If it is any other character, leave it unchanged.

description_json.name: QWERTY monoalphabetic substitution cipher
description_json.idea: A fixed one-to-one substitution over the English alphabet. Each plaintext letter is replaced by exactly one ciphertext letter using a single bijection, and the mapping is the same for uppercase and lowercase letters. Non-letter characters are left unchanged.
description_json.encrypt_rules: Use the following bijection: plaintext alphabet abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz -> ciphertext alphabet qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm. Thus a->q, b->w, c->e, d->r, e->t, f->y, g->u, h->i, i->o, j->p, k->a, l->s, m->d, n->f, o->g, p->h, q->j, r->k, s->l, t->z, u->x, v->c, w->v, x->b, y->n, z->m. Uppercase letters use the same mapping, preserving case. All non-letter characters remain unchanged.
description_json.decrypt_rules: Use the inverse bijection: ciphertext alphabet qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm -> plaintext alphabet abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz. Thus q->a, w->b, e->c, r->d, t->e, y->f, u->g, i->h, o->i, p->j, a->k, s->l, d->m, f->n, g->o, h->p, j->q, k->r, l->s, z->t, x->u, c->v, v->w, b->x, n->y, m->z. Uppercase letters use the same mapping, preserving case. All non-letter characters remain unchanged.
